e.title: PowMCP Skills：把技能里的「证据步骤」外置为托管检查，并明写「它不能证明什么」
e.title_en: PowMCP Skills: externalising a Skill’s evidence step into hosted checks, and stating plainly what it does not prove
e.title_hk: PowMCP Skills：把技能裡的「證據步驟」外置為託管檢查，並明寫「它不能證明什麼」
e.summary: 11 个面向「有标准符合性要求」的重复性工作的 Agent 技能：每个技能教完整流程——收集什么、跑哪个托管检查、如何读结果、它不能证明什么、以及如何交付；发布前经确定性门禁、与「仅用工具」基线在真实无头智能体中的实测对比、以及独立三席委员会评审，技能本身不含脚本、自身不发起网络请求
e.summary_en: Eleven agent Skills for recurring jobs that carry standards-conformance requirements: each teaches the whole job — what to gather, which hosted check to run, how to read the result, what it does not prove, and how to hand off; before publication each passed a deterministic gate, a measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents, and an independent three-seat committee appraisal, and the Skills themselves carry no scripts and make no network calls
e.summary_hk: 11 個面向「有標準符合性要求」的重複性工作的 Agent 技能：每個技能教完整流程——收集什麼、跑哪個託管檢查、如何讀結果、它不能證明什麼、以及如何交付；發布前經確定性門禁、與「僅用工具」基線在真實無頭智能體中的實測對比、以及獨立三席委員會評審，技能本身不含腳本、自身不發起網絡請求
e.body:
**PowMCP Skills** 是一组**把「证据步骤」外置为托管检查的 Agent 技能**（仓库 `powmcp/skills`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言未标注、创建于 2026-09-10、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；⚠️ **GitHub API 实测其 `size` 为 0 KB**——**该值与「仓库含 11 个 SKILL.md」不相称，故我改用 contents 接口独立核实：`skills/` 目录实测返回**11 个条目**，名称与 README 表格一一对应**（**见下**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「Agent 技能里的证据自觉」**中的**第四种——也是最彻底的一种：把证据外置、并明写证据的边界****。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，8,771 字节**）：⭐ **README 逐字定位**：**「Agent Skills for recurring jobs whose evidence step is a hosted PowMCP check. Each skill teaches the whole job: what to gather, which check to run, how to read the result, what it does not prove, and how to hand off. The procedure stands on its own; the PowMCP tool is the verified-evidence step inside it.」**——**即：技能教的是**整件事**（收集什么／跑哪个检查／怎么读结果／**它不能证明什么**／怎么交付），**而托管检查只是其中那个「已被验证的证据步骤」**。**安装方式逐字实测**：`npx skills add powmcp/skills`（或 `--skill <skill-name>` 指定单个）；**支持客户端逐字实测**为 **Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Gemini CLI、OpenClaw**（原文续以「and every cli…」）。⭐⭐ **`skills/` 目录经 contents 接口实测返回 11 个条目，逐字为**：**`attach-regulator-ready-bom-to-release`（SBOM 符合性：CycloneDX／SPDX，含「面向欧盟市场须满足 BSI TR-03183-2 下限：CycloneDX 1.6+ 或 SPDX 3.0.1+」）**、**`diagnose-rejected-invoice-before-resubmission`（EN 16931／Peppol／CIUS 电子发票符合性）**、**`gate-published-release-before-announcement`（npm 包检查）**、**`preflight-caption-track-before-client-handoff`（WebVTT／SRT／TTML 字幕轨，含「20 CPS 或 17 CPS」阅读速度证据）**、**`preflight-client-endpoint-before-integration`（FHIR 服务端符合性：US Core、SMART discovery）**、**`preflight-retailer-bound-epub`（EPUB 2/3 与 EPUBCheck）**、**`produce-client-site-handoff-report`（链接完整性证据）**、**`publish-service-change-feed`（GTFS Schedule 校验，含美国 NTD 报送）**、**`publish-weekly-episode-without-feed-breakage`（播客 RSS）**、**`substantiate-eu-ebook-accessibility-claim`（EPUB Accessibility 1.1／欧洲无障碍法 EAA／WCAG）**、**`verify-payment-page-header-change-after-deploy`（支付页 HTTP 安全响应头，⭐ **PCI DSS v4.0.1 第 11.6.1 条证据**，并要求**至少每七天监测一次**）**。⭐⭐ **「Provenance（来源与把关）」一节逐字实测，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「Every skill in this repository passed a deterministic gate, a measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents, and an independent three-seat committee appraisal before publication. Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls of their own.」**——**即每个技能发布前经过**三道门**：**① 确定性门禁 ② 在真实无头智能体中、与「仅用工具」基线的实测对比 ③ 独立三席委员会评审**；**且技能本身**不含脚本、自身不发起网络请求****。**章节结构逐字实测**：**Install / Skills / How the checks are metered（检查如何计量） / Connect an endpoint by hand / ⭐Provenance / Feedback**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「what it does not prove（它不能证明什么）」被写进技能定义本身，是本轮最有价值的发现**——**绝大多数工具只声明能力，不声明边界**；**而这里**每个技能都在定义里写明自己不能证明什么****，**并且表格中每个技能都带一句「Not for …」（不适用于……）的排除条款**（**例如 SBOM 技能注明「Not for generating the SBOM from the release build」，字幕技能注明「Not for generating, translating, or burning captions into video」）**；**对一个以「标注核实层级」为方法的站点，这是同一种纪律的**最纯粹工程化**：**把适用边界做成技能契约的一部分，而不是写在文档角落****（**可与池内 [[phi-boundary-gate]] 的边界门控、同轮 [[insurance-review]] 的「待核实事项」、[[thinking-framework-skills]] 的证据分级并读——**四条都在处理「工具不知道自己不知道什么」这一 AI 时代的核心风险**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「与『仅用工具』基线在真实无头智能体中的实测对比」是一种少见的评估设计**——**它问的不是「技能有没有用」，而是「**加了技能之后，比只用工具强多少**」**；**这正是**增量有效性**的正确问法**，**与池内 [[insqabench]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 的基准思路一致但更严格——**因为它要求一个 ablation 基线**（**⚠️ 本次未读其评测结果，故不转述任何数值或结论**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 11 个技能里有至少四个直接围绕**监管/标准符合性证据**：**PCI DSS v4.0.1 第 11.6.1 条（每七天监测支付页安全头）**、**BSI TR-03183-2（欧盟市场软件物料清单下限）**、**欧洲无障碍法（EAA）与 EPUB Accessibility 1.1**、**美国 NTD 报送（GTFS）**——**即「**合规证据的自动生成**」已成为一个独立的技能品类**；**对保险与风险专业，这与**审计留痕、监管报送、控制点证据**是同一件事**（**可与池内 [[insurance-governance]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]] 并读**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls of their own」是一条可被验证的安全属性承诺**——**它意味着技能是**纯程序性文本，不含可执行代码、也不自行外联****；**对需要在受管环境中评估第三方技能的学生，这是一个可核对的判断依据**（**⚠️ 本次未逐文件核对 11 个 SKILL.md 是否真的不含脚本或网络调用，故仅转述其声明**）。**⑤ ⭐ "How the checks are metered" 单设一节，说明托管检查是**计量/计费**的**——**这一点对成本评估重要**（**本次未读，故不转述其计量方式与价格**）。**⑥ ⭐ FHIR 服务端检查把该技能组接入了**健康数据交换标准****——**可与池内 [[cms-beneficiary-fhir]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]]、[[icd-hcc-mappings]] 并读：**那些是健康险数据与映射，本技能是**交换端点的符合性前置检查****。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ GitHub API 实测 `size` 为 0 KB，与该仓库含 11 个技能文件不相称**——**本词条据此**不采信该字段**，改以 contents 接口独立核实 `skills/` 下确为 11 个条目**，**并如实记录两处实测值的差异**；**② ⭐⭐ 「deterministic gate / 与 tools-only 基线的实测对比 / 独立三席委员会」三项均为**README 自述**——**本词条不主张其已被独立证实，也不转述任何评审结论或评测数值**（**本次未读「How the checks are metered」正文，亦未找到其评测报告**）；**③ ⭐ 「技能不含脚本、自身不发起网络请求」为**README 自述**——**本次未逐个打开 11 个 `SKILL.md` 核对**，**故不主张该属性已在文件层面被验证**；**④** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README 全文（8,771 字节）的定位语句、安装方式、支持客户端、11 个技能名称及其「PowMCP checks」对应项、以及 Provenance 与章节结构**，**但未安装任何技能、未在 Agent 客户端运行、未打开任何 SKILL.md 正文、未使用任何托管检查、未访问 powmcp.com**，因此**不能转述其流程步骤、检查项细节、判定标准、计量方式或价格**；**⑤ ⭐ 表格中「Use when …」的适用条件与「Not for …」的排除条款均为**README 摘要****，**我按摘要转述并标注为自述**；**⑥ ⭐ 涉及 PCI DSS、BSI TR-03183-2、EN 16931、EAA、NTD 等标准的具体条款要求**，**本次均未查阅标准原文核实**，**故仅转述技能自述所对应的标准名称与版本**；**⑦ 该仓库与商业托管服务 powmcp.com 的关系（是否同一主体、是否需付费）本次未核实**；**⑧ ★0、fork 0 且创建与推送同日**，**说明其极新且关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、稳定性或已被采用**；**⑨ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/powmcp/skills`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/skills` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（**contents 接口返回 11 个条目，与 README 表格一一对应**）；**未安装、未运行、未打开技能正文、未访问 powmcp.com**。
e.body_en:
**PowMCP Skills** is a set of **agent Skills that externalise their evidence step into hosted checks** (repository `powmcp/skills`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★0, 0 forks, no declared primary language, created 2026-09-10 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**); ⚠️ **the GitHub API measurably reports `size` as 0 KB** — **a value inconsistent with a repository containing 11 SKILL.md files, so I verified independently via the contents API: `skills/` measurably returns 11 entries whose names correspond one-to-one with the README table** (**below**). It belongs to the fourth and most thorough of this round’s ways agent Skills handle evidence: **externalising the evidence and stating the evidence’s limits**. Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 8,771-byte README**): ⭐ **the README positions it verbatim**: **"Agent Skills for recurring jobs whose evidence step is a hosted PowMCP check. Each skill teaches the whole job: what to gather, which check to run, how to read the result, what it does not prove, and how to hand off. The procedure stands on its own; the PowMCP tool is the verified-evidence step inside it."** — **i.e. the Skill teaches the whole job (what to gather, which check to run, how to read the result, what it does not prove, how to hand off), and the hosted check is merely the verified-evidence step inside it**. **Install read verbatim**: `npx skills add powmcp/skills` (or `--skill <skill-name>` for one). **Supported clients read verbatim**: **Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw** (continuing "and every cli…"). ⭐⭐ **The `skills/` directory measurably returns 11 entries via the contents API**: **`attach-regulator-ready-bom-to-release`** (SBOM conformance — CycloneDX/SPDX, including the EU-market floor of BSI TR-03183-2, i.e. CycloneDX 1.6+ or SPDX 3.0.1+); **`diagnose-rejected-invoice-before-resubmission`** (EN 16931/Peppol/CIUS e-invoice conformance); **`gate-published-release-before-announcement`** (npm package check); **`preflight-caption-track-before-client-handoff`** (WebVTT/SRT/TTML, including 20 CPS or 17 CPS reading-speed evidence); **`preflight-client-endpoint-before-integration`** (FHIR server conformance — US Core, SMART discovery); **`preflight-retailer-bound-epub`** (EPUB 2/3, EPUBCheck); **`produce-client-site-handoff-report`** (link-integrity evidence); **`publish-service-change-feed`** (GTFS Schedule validation, including US NTD reporting); **`publish-weekly-episode-without-feed-breakage`** (podcast RSS); **`substantiate-eu-ebook-accessibility-claim`** (EPUB Accessibility 1.1, European Accessibility Act, WCAG); and **`verify-payment-page-header-change-after-deploy`** (payment-page HTTP security headers, ⭐ **PCI DSS v4.0.1 Requirement 11.6.1 evidence**, requiring monitoring **at least once every seven days**). ⭐⭐ **The "Provenance" section, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important passage**: **"Every skill in this repository passed a deterministic gate, a measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents, and an independent three-seat committee appraisal before publication. Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls of their own."** — **three gates before publication: ① a deterministic gate, ② a measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents, ③ an independent three-seat committee appraisal**; **and the Skills themselves carry no scripts and make no network calls**. **Section headings read verbatim**: **Install / Skills / How the checks are metered / Connect an endpoint by hand / ⭐ Provenance / Feedback**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ That "what it does not prove" is written into the Skill definition itself is the round’s most valuable finding** — **almost every tool declares capabilities, not boundaries**; **here every Skill states in its definition what it cannot prove**, **and every row of the table carries a "Not for …" exclusion** (**the SBOM Skill notes "Not for generating the SBOM from the release build"; the caption Skill notes "Not for generating, translating, or burning captions into video"**); **for a site whose method is labelling verification tiers, this is the purest engineering of the same discipline: making applicability boundaries part of the Skill contract rather than a footnote** (**readable with the boundary gating of [[phi-boundary-gate]], the "items to verify" tier of [[insurance-review]] and the evidence grading of [[thinking-framework-skills]] — all four address the core AI-era risk that a tool does not know what it does not know**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ A measured evaluation against a tools-only baseline in real headless agents is an unusual evaluation design** — **it does not ask whether the Skill is useful but how much better it is than the tools alone**; **that is the right question for incremental effectiveness**, **aligned with the benchmarking of [[insqabench]], [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] and [[actuarial-benchmarks]] but stricter, because it requires an ablation baseline** (**its evaluation results were not read, so no figure or conclusion is restated**). **③ ⭐⭐ At least four of the eleven Skills centre on regulatory and standards-conformance evidence**: **PCI DSS v4.0.1 Requirement 11.6.1 (security-header monitoring every seven days)**, **BSI TR-03183-2 (EU software bill-of-materials floor)**, **the European Accessibility Act and EPUB Accessibility 1.1**, and **US NTD reporting (GTFS)** — **i.e. automated compliance-evidence generation has become a Skill category of its own**; **for insurance and risk professionals this is the same thing as audit trails, regulatory reporting and control-point evidence** (**readable with [[insurance-governance]], [[naic-ai-oversight]] and [[iso-42001-toolkit]]**). **④ ⭐⭐ "Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls of their own" is a checkable security property** — **the Skills are purely procedural text, with no executable code and no outbound connections of their own**; **a verifiable criterion for students assessing third-party Skills in managed environments** (**⚠️ the 11 SKILL.md files were not opened individually, so this is reported as a declaration only**). **⑤ ⭐ A separate "How the checks are metered" section shows the hosted checks are metered** — **relevant to cost assessment** (**not read, so no metering scheme or price is restated**). **⑥ ⭐ The FHIR server check connects this Skill set to health-data-exchange standards** — **readable with [[cms-beneficiary-fhir]], [[healthcare-mrf-api]] and [[icd-hcc-mappings]]: those are health-insurance data and mappings, whereas this is a pre-integration conformance check on the exchange endpoint**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The GitHub API measurably reports `size` as 0 KB, inconsistent with a repository holding 11 Skill files** — **the field is therefore not relied upon; the contents API was used instead and confirms 11 entries under `skills/`**, **with the discrepancy between the two measurements recorded**; **② ⭐⭐ The deterministic gate, the measured comparison against a tools-only baseline, and the independent three-seat committee are all README self-reports** — **the entry does not claim they are independently confirmed and restates no appraisal conclusion or evaluation figure** (**"How the checks are metered" was not read, and no evaluation report was located**); **③ ⭐ "Skills carry no scripts and make no network calls" is a README self-report** — **the 11 `SKILL.md` files were not opened individually**, **so no claim is made that the property has been verified at file level**; **④** this check verified **the repository metadata, the README’s 8,771 bytes in respect of its positioning statement, install method, supported clients, the 11 Skill names and their corresponding hosted checks, and the Provenance and section structure**, **but installed no Skill, ran nothing in an agent client, opened no SKILL.md, used no hosted check and did not visit powmcp.com**, so **its procedure steps, check details, pass criteria, metering scheme and price cannot be restated**; **⑤ ⭐ The "Use when …" conditions and "Not for …" exclusions in the table are README summaries**, **restated as such**; **⑥ ⭐ The specific clause requirements of PCI DSS, BSI TR-03183-2, EN 16931, the EAA and NTD were not checked against the standards themselves**, **so only the standard names and versions the Skills claim to correspond to are restated**; **⑦ the relationship between this repository and the commercial hosted service powmcp.com (same entity? paid?) was not verified**; **⑧ ★0, 0 forks and same-day creation and push mean it is extremely new with very low attention**, **so no maturity, stability or adoption is claimed**; **⑨ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/powmcp/skills`, `/readme` and `/contents/skills` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (**the contents endpoint returning 11 entries corresponding one-to-one with the README table**); **nothing installed or run, no Skill body opened, powmcp.com not visited**.
